exposure: Women with anemia and gestational hypertension
Women with gestational hypertension without anemia
Women with chronic hypertension and younger age (<35 years old)
Women with chronic hypertension and advanced maternal age (≥35 years old)
cohort: 40,212 deliveries from a single tertiary healthcare center in Greater Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, between January 2010 and December 2020
finding: Nulliparity, previous history of preeclampsia, and multiple pregnancies were associated with an increased risk of preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Instrumental and cesarean delivery was significantly associated with preeclampsia.
